versions.changelog:
Initial release of minecraft-building-server skill pack.

- Introduces workflows for Minecraft Java Edition creative building on top of a running server, including FAWE/WorldEdit editing, bot-assisted builds, schematic pipelines, material production, redstone automation, and villager trading.
- Clearly separates building workflow guidance from server infrastructure management; does not cover server ops, backups, plugin installation, health monitoring, PvP, or Bedrock topics.
- Defines activation rules and trigger conditions; only activates for build-focused topics, not for server lifecycle or moderation.
- Enforces strict safety rules regarding bot use, automation, and permissions; warns and requires confirmation for ambiguous contexts.
- Provides reference selection guidance to efficiently support common building scenarios.
